title: Add docstring to `Atoms.get_masses`

comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
I wonder if this is the same on all machines.

The doctest documentation has some discussion of this problem: https://docs.python.org/3/library/doctest.html#warnings

I suggest

```
>>> total_mass = atoms.get_masses().sum()
>>> print(f'{total_mass:f}')
16.043000 
```

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body: Thank you @askhl for finding the issue! Now I have fixed as you suggested.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: The comment suggests a specific code change to replace the doctest example with a formatted float print to ensure consistent output across machines.

comments.author: yuzie007
comments.body:
Thank you @askhl once again for the review!

The MR is just adding an example, which is `doctest`ed, without modifying any functionalities, so I believe it's OK to merge now.
